provenance.method: Owner-authorized HTTPS POST; certificate validation enabled; redirects disabled; 20-second timeout; 1 MB response limit
provenance.scope: Read-only discovery of the supplied account and its one visible heater
provenance.redaction: Allowlist projection; identity aliases replaced consistently; product ID replaced to avoid implying an approved profile key; house, serial, radio identifiers and nicknames omitted
provenance.limitations: One visible device; ownership/shared role unknown; null pagination metadata does not establish absence of pagination
